# Daily Dashboard V0.5.8

The weather widget now follows the time of day at its forecast location and lets you inspect the hourly chart.

- Hover over either temperature or rain to show a vertical guide and a compact readout of the hour, temperature and hourly chance of rain. Readouts stay inside the graph at its edges and at high scaling.
- The graph also supports keyboard focus, Left/Right arrows, Home/End and Escape.
- The sunrise card places a sun marker along its daylight arc using the current local time. At night, the marker moves below the horizon. Future forecast days show their daylight arc without a current-time marker.
- Warm sunrise and sunset colours blend into the usual daytime palette. The widget becomes darker at night while keeping text and controls readable. The clock refreshes automatically.
- Sunrise/sunset and graph times use the forecast location's clock, including when the computer uses a different time zone. Missing hourly rain probabilities display as unavailable.

The changes use the shared Windows/macOS frontend. The application identity and saved settings location remain unchanged for upgrades.

## Verification

Production build and frontend regressions pass. The complete 456-case widget matrix includes graph hover and keyboard checks at all 76 weather size/display combinations. Solar browser checks cover 80 state/size/display combinations, remote computer time zones, future forecast days and live clock updates. Unit checks cover hourly probability parsing, pointer scaling, daylight progress, smooth dawn/dusk/night transitions, DST and date rollover.
